arrive.text: Your study. On the desk, something you built: a little world, running.

look.text: Tiny people, living tiny lives. To them, it's all real.

nested.text: And in their world, someone is building one too.

more.text: One world can run many. And each of those can run more.

ask.text: If worlds like this are easy to make, how many are real? And which kind is yours?

pullout.text: Somewhere, someone may be looking at you the same way.

off_end.text: You switch them off. Above you, the lights flicker.

run_end.text: You let them run. Maybe someone is doing the same for you.

window.text: Outside, the sky. You've never actually checked how far it goes.

photo.text: A photo of you as a child. You don't remember it being taken.
